questions.explanation: Here, “hear about” means “to receive information about something”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“hear about”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to receive information about something”。对应源表释义为“听说”。

questions.listenScript: Hold on a moment! I need to tie my shoe before we leave.

listenLines.text: Hold on a moment! I need to tie my shoe before we leave.

translation.stem: 听词条或句子，选择相符的英文释义。
translation.listenScript: 等一下！出发前，我需要系好鞋带。

questions.explanation: Here, “hold on” means “to wait a short time”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“hold on”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to wait a short time”。对应源表释义为“①等会儿 ②别挂断”。

questions.stem: Which expression would the teacher use to ask them to move faster?
questions.listenScript: The school bus leaves in two minutes. The teacher tells the children to move faster and put their bags on quickly.

listenLines.text: The school bus leaves in two minutes. The teacher tells the children to move faster and put their bags on quickly.

questions.explanation: The situation supports “hurry up”: The school bus leaves in two minutes. The teacher tells the children to move faster and put their bags on quickly.
questions.parentExplanation: 情境证据：校车两分钟后就要开了。老师让孩子们动作快些，迅速背好书包。；对应本题“赶快，急忙”这一用法。

translation.stem: 老师会用哪个表达催他们快一点？
translation.listenScript: 校车两分钟后就要开了。老师让孩子们动作快些，迅速背好书包。

questions.stem: Which expression describes the way Ben leaves home?
questions.listenScript: Ben leaves home so quickly that he forgets his lunch. He runs to the bus stop without checking his bag.

listenLines.text: Ben leaves home so quickly that he forgets his lunch. He runs to the bus stop without checking his bag.

questions.explanation: The situation supports “in a hurry”: Ben leaves home so quickly that he forgets his lunch. He runs to the bus stop without checking his bag.
questions.parentExplanation: 情境证据：本离家太急，忘带了午餐。他没检查书包就跑向车站。；对应本题“匆忙，赶快”这一用法。

translation.stem: 哪个表达描述本离家时的状态？
translation.listenScript: 本离家太急，忘带了午餐。他没检查书包就跑向车站。

questions.stem:
Some people think Ben is shy. In fact, he enjoys speaking to large groups.
What does “In fact” mean here?

translation.stem: 一些人认为本很害羞。事实上，他喜欢在很多人面前讲话。 这里“In fact”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “in fact” means “used to introduce what is really true”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“in fact”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“used to introduce what is really true”。对应源表释义为“①实际上，事实上②确切地说”。

options.label: B
options.text: at the same moment as something else

options.label: C
options.text: finally, after a sequence of events or effort

options.label: D
options.text: during every step of an activity

questions.stem:
We try three different methods. In the end, the last one works.
What does “In the end” mean here?

translation.stem: 我们试了三种方法。最后，第三种成功了。 这里“In the end”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “in the end” means “finally, after a sequence of events or effort”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“in the end”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“finally, after a sequence of events or effort”。对应源表释义为“最后，终于”。

options.text: a team game played over a net

options.label: B

questions.stem:
Our club offers ballet and modern dance. I choose the second class for its free movements.
What does “modern dance” mean here?

translation.stem: 我们的社团开设芭蕾舞和现代舞。我选择第二门课，因为它的动作自由。 这里“modern dance”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “modern dance” means “a style of dance with free movements that differs from classical ballet”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“modern dance”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“a style of dance with free movements that differs from classical ballet”。对应源表释义为“现代舞”。

options.label: B
options.text: a height that is neither tall nor short

options.label: C
options.text: a height far above most people

questions.stem:
Tom is neither tall nor short. He is of medium height.
What does “medium height” mean here?

translation.stem: 汤姆既不高也不矮。他中等身高。 这里“medium height”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “medium height” means “a height that is neither tall nor short”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“medium height”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“a height that is neither tall nor short”。对应源表释义为“中等身高”。

questions.stem: Mia h________ the new library from her teacher and tells us the news.
questions.hint: Use the phrase meaning learns news concerning something; agree with Mia.
questions.explanation: Mia learns news about the library; a singular subject takes hears.
questions.parentExplanation: 图书馆是听说的消息对象，用hears about；不要混作hear from。

translation.stem: 米娅从老师那里听说了新图书馆，并把消息告诉我们。

questions.stem: Please h________ while I get Dad to the phone. Do not end the call.
questions.hint: Use the two-word phone request meaning keep the line connected and wait.
questions.explanation: The listener must stay on the call, so hold on is the phone request.
questions.parentExplanation: 电话中请求别挂断，用hold on；语境明确不是结束通话。 此语境中同义的hang on也可接受；本词条的规范示例仍为hold on。

translation.stem: 请别挂断，我去叫爸爸来接电话。不要结束通话。

questions.stem: Please h________! The bus leaves in two minutes, and we are still at home.
questions.hint: Use the two-word command meaning act faster.
questions.explanation: The short time before departure calls for hurry up.
questions.parentExplanation: 催促动作快一点，用hurry up；hurry在此为动词。

translation.stem: 请快点！公交车两分钟后就开，我们还在家里。

questions.stem: I cannot stop to chat; I am i________ because my lesson starts in one minute.
questions.hint: Use the three-word phrase describing someone who is rushing for lack of time.
questions.explanation: A very close deadline makes the speaker in a hurry.
questions.parentExplanation: 时间不足而匆忙，用in a hurry，冠词a不可省略。

translation.stem: 我不能停下来聊天；课程一分钟后开始，我很匆忙。

questions.stem: There are many books on the shelf—eighty, i________.
questions.hint: Use the two-word phrase that adds an exact true detail after a general statement.
questions.explanation: Eighty gives a precise true detail after many books, introduced by in fact.
questions.parentExplanation: 先说很多，再补充确切数字，用in fact。

translation.stem: 架子上有很多书，确切地说，是八十本。

questions.stem: The bus is late, but we reach the station i________ after a long wait.
questions.hint: Use a three-word expression meaning finally.
questions.explanation: Reaching the station is the eventual outcome after the delay.
questions.parentExplanation: 延误后的最终到达，用in the end；不能写at the end of后不接宾语。

translation.stem: 公交车晚点了，但久等之后，我们最终到达车站。

questions.stem: Someone calls from behind you. Please t________ to see who it is.
questions.hint: move your body to face the opposite way
questions.explanation: Here, “turn around” means “move your body to face the opposite direction”. Please is followed by the base form turn around.
questions.parentExplanation: Please后的祈使句用turn around原形。完整句意：有人从你背后喊你。请转身看看是谁。

translation.stem: 有人从你背后喊你。请转身看看是谁。

questions.stem: Use this r________ to move the toy boat while you stand safely on the bank.
questions.hint: a device for operating a machine from a distance
questions.explanation: Here, “remote control” means “a device for operating a machine from a distance”. This introduces one remote control.
questions.parentExplanation: this后填单数短语remote control。完整句意：你安全地站在岸边，用这个遥控器操纵玩具船。

translation.stem: 你安全地站在岸边，用这个遥控器操纵玩具船。

questions.stem: What does “cries himself to sleep” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “cries himself to sleep” means “cries until he falls asleep”. The sentence says: He misses his family and cries himself to sleep in a quiet room.
questions.parentExplanation: “cries himself to sleep”在此处对应“哭着入睡”中的本句义项；句意为：他想念家人，在安静的房间里哭着睡着了。

translation.stem: 短文中的“cries himself to sleep”是什么意思？

questions.stem: What does “cry out” mean in this passage?
questions.explanation: Here “cry out” means “shout or call loudly”. The sentence says: The next morning, he hears someone cry out beside the garden gate.
questions.parentExplanation: “cry out”在此处对应“大叫；叫喊”中的本句义项；句意为：第二天早晨，他听到有人在花园门旁大叫。

questions.stem: Which title fits best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Making a Balloon Story Move”. Evidence: Our class builds paper hot-air balloons for a story display. The balloons hang from strings above a painted mountain scene. In our story, one balloon can rise into the clear morning sky. We move its string slowly to show the beginning of the journey. The teacher stays nearby to watch over the children using the tall display stand. She holds the stand steady while we attach the last paper cloud. When everything is ready, younger visitors follow the balloon's journey with their eyes.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Making a Balloon Story Move”。原文依据：我们班为故事展示制作纸热气球。这些气球用线悬挂在画好的山景上方。在我们的故事里，一个气球能升入晴朗的晨空。我们慢慢移动它的线，展示旅程的开始。老师待在附近，照管使用高展示架的孩子们。我们固定最后一朵纸云时，她扶稳展示架。一切准备好后，年幼的参观者用目光跟随气球的旅程。
